description: Frederik, Joeri Alexis and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The deposit contains experimental wind-tunnel datasets accompanying the periodic dynamic induction-control study. The associated method varies turbine induction sinusoidally and assesses potential power gains, with structural damage-equivalent loads studied separately in simulation. This data record represents the wind-tunnel observations, not the complete numerical model or a field-scale wind-farm campaign. The brief metadata do not state every measured variable, test duration or sampling rate. The associated control-model record preserves the distinction between scaled experimental evidence and simulated load effects. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
